description: Defines the CachingCertVerifier class which caches certificate verification results to optimize performance and reduce redundant verifications. Contains class declarations, methods, and internal cache management logic.

classes.name: CachingCertVerifier
classes.description: A certificate verifier that caches verification results to improve efficiency.

classes.name: CachedResult
classes.description: Holds the result of a certificate verification, including error code and verification details.

classes.name: CacheValidityPeriod
classes.description: Represents the validity period of a cached verification result based on system time.

classes.name: CacheExpirationFunctor
classes.description: Determines if a cached result is still valid based on current time and expiration.

methods.name: CachingCertVerifier
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the verifier with a delegate verifier.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Performs certificate verification, using cache if available.

methods.name: SetConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration parameters for the verifier.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for verifier events.

methods.name: OnRequestFinished
methods.description: Handles completion of a verification request, updates cache.

methods.name: OnCertVerifierChanged
methods.description: Callback when the verifier configuration changes.

methods.name: OnCertDBChanged
methods.description: Callback when the certificate database changes.
